hotspot.description: Hypothetical authorised contaminant hotspot for a demonstration. Not a located real site, and not an ordnance object. Real work near historical marine munitions requires specialist and environmental approval [S02, S03].
hotspot.label: synthetic_demo

media.source_ref: keratin biosorption literature derated for seawater; see docs/MATERIAL_KERATIN.md [K1-K4]

assumed fraction of a conditional sulfur-site calculation [K4]; 476.7 mg/g reported for reduced human hair [K15] is not a validated capacity for this core in seawater. Seawater Hg is above 99 per cent chloro-complexed [K10]. Hg uptake also depends strongly on sulfide, chloride and dissolved organic matter [S04]. See docs/MATERIAL_KERATIN.md section 3

wool keratin nanofibre Cu(II) Langmuir capacity 20 mg/g [K9], derated by an order of magnitude for a bulk felt core, then limited by organic complexation: above 99 per cent of dissolved Cu in seawater is bound to strong ligands [K11]. See docs/MATERIAL_KERATIN.md section 3b
